units.source_text: 千重子在花季的清水寺曾跟真一谈过自己是个弃儿。

en.t: At Kiyomizu Temple during the flower season, Chieko had once told Shinichi that she was an abandoned child.

units.source_text: 这事，真一的哥哥龙助恐怕也有所闻。

en.t: Shinichi's older brother Ryusuke had probably heard something about this too.

units.source_text: 即使真一没有告诉他哥哥，但两家铺子很近，消息自然会传过去。

en.t: Even if Shinichi had not told his brother, the two shops were close to each other, so the news would naturally have reached him.
Perhaps that is how one could understand it.
